pinreg_r4: r4 (2026-10-15): die master is pin-registered (PR=1, tools/qwen_split/d2d_pinreg_gen.py): every functional port has one flop at its pin, placed FIRM at the pin by recipe-2 io_flop_at_pins; fixes qkd r1 EARLY_FAIL_SETUP (-434 ps, all boundary paths) and qfd r1 TT -79 / FF -32.6.
structural_change: sf7w = PARALLEL fallback of sf7 (same RTL qfd_d2d_static_ovl_sf7): the sf5w geometry (single macro row y 43.2, x 43.2/129.6/216/302.4, 388.8 x 172.8, GRT overflow 0 on SF5) and the sf5w pin plan unchanged (no GEN face change).

pin_regs.reason: RTL is already pin-registered: d2d_pinreg_gen.py PR=1 wraps qfd_d2d_static_core with exactly one flop per functional port (FIRM at the pin via io_flop_at_pins); the link calendar is compiled --pinreg; a second synthesized pin register would add +1 cycle per port with no timing purpose

reset_landing.reason: the RTL lands it: ot_rst_pipe u_reset_regions / u_por_region s0 -> s1 (kept 2-flop capture, async assert / sync release, FIRM at the E-face rst_n / por_n pins by local_reset_capture.tcl; port net = 2 sinks), then 8 equal-depth regional copies (RC 1, each <= ~160 loads; r9j 300/325 on one flop). A kit landing would add 2 more stages and rename u_core (breaks the capture anchor).

safe_design.1_pins: PASS: every functional port has its own pin flop (PR=1), KEPT pin-flop copies for cfg_data, cal_start[_rx] (7), cal_seg[_rx] (6), result_v (22); reset lands in the RTL 2-flop face capture (u_reset_regions / u_por_region s0/s1, FIRM at the E rst_n/por_n pins by local_reset_capture.tcl); kit reset_landing opt-out (RTL lands it).
safe_design.2_reach: PASS by construction: 388.8 x 172.8 outline, pin flop to farthest macro pin < 405 um Manhattan; gate timing confirms.
safe_design.3_fanout: FIXED in source (SF7, ot_qwen_d2d_safe7.sv): whole-block native census 0 non-tie roots > 32 (max FF 32, comb 32, input 22, macro 1; SF6S 221 unsafe) with KEPT non-parametric leaf copies (synth_keep_modules): 36-copy equal-depth reset tree, 25 epoch-begin copies, per-group halt/start/segment/advance/write-enable copies, one-hot twins, 2-level table-write decode; tie nets split by ORFS repair_tie_fanout. No ODB copy hooks.
safe_design.4_depth: PASS: logic depth unchanged or shallower (copies only); gate confirms.
safe_design.5_storage: PASS: slot store = 4 x 64x137 SRAM macros; calendar tables 2 x 1 kb flops (<2 kb) written by a kept decode, read by registered one-hot twins; TXD 1-bit capture delays <= 10 deep (waived: a ring costs more).
safe_design.6_floorplan: macros 2 x 2 / row on the 43.2 lattice [(43.2, 43.2), (129.6, 43.2), (216.0, 43.2), (302.4, 43.2)], 10.8 um halos, full-width std band; pins 0.192 um on full faces (N 1674 pins over 321.216/388.8 um (83%), S 1170 pins over 224.448/388.8 um (58%), W 758 pins over 145.344/172.8 um (84%), E 66 pins over 12.48/172.8 um (7%)); aspect 2.25. Fill 24.8%: pin-bound (fill_reason.pin_bound, measured demand), the 40-60% synthesis-area target is infeasible for 3,668 ports at the legal pitch.
safe_design.7_clock: Centre-fed: ck on the N centre track (194.412), CTS sink clustering 20/40; io_hold_margin 0.03; gate measures spread <= 80 TT+FF.
safe_design.8_schedule: PASS: 0 added edges (200k lockstep vs qfd_d2d_static_ovl; 35-layer pair bit-exact at TXDP [8,3,1,10] = compiled_L1 dv2f18dh2). Static calendars, no credits/backpressure.

fill_reason.pin_bound: pin-bound: 3,668 functional ports (548-bit native/program/RX payloads, 583-bit FDI flits, 524-bit x3) at the 0.192 um legal pin pitch (5.2/um, rule <= 6/um) need 704 um of face; qfd_d2d_static_sf7w 388.8 x 172.8 gives fill 24.8% (macros 10580 + synth std 6085 um2); per face N 1674 pins over 321.216/388.8 um (83%), S 1170 pins over 224.448/388.8 um (58%), W 758 pins over 145.344/172.8 um (84%), E 66 pins over 12.48/172.8 um (7%). A 35-40% outline (<= 47.6k um2, perimeter <= ~870 um) would need >= 81% of the whole perimeter and every face >= 90% full, and the 2 x 2 lattice macros need >= 186 um height.
